body:
Pilot executed 2026-07-02 (background session). Results:

- **Baseline audit:** 36 pass / 22 gap (1 N/A) — full table, exit 0, every gap detail actionable.
- **Manifest:** `_meta/mise-en-place.yml` written and filled — `owner: mhi-raptorxai`, `repo: raptorgpt-agents`, `default_branch: dev` (verified via origin/HEAD; the issue's "likely dev" guess was right).
- **Plan:** 19 create / 6 conflict / 2 manual / 32 ok. All 5 template conflicts (PR template, ci.yml, claude.yml, lefthook.yml, .gitignore) printed diffs, files left byte-identical.
- **Apply:** 24 paths created; `git status` shows only untracked additions — **additive-only proven**.
- **Re-audit: 56 pass / 3 gap.** Remaining gaps all justified: CLAUDE-07 migration debt (`.claude/commands/`) · ROOT-03 AGENTS.md (authored content) · IGNORE-01 (`_meta/operations/` not ignored — owner hand-edit of `.gitignore`, secret-risk).
- **Idempotence:** second `--plan` = 0 create.
- TC-013 + TC-010 observations recorded in the vault test plans.

**Finding routed → #38:** scaffold creates `.mcp.json` which the pilot repo's own `.gitignore` swallows — invisible in review diff, won't survive a clone; scaffold should warn. No standards over-strictness observed — every conflict was a legitimate repo customization, correctly untouched.

**Henry:** working tree in the pilot checkout (branch `uat`) holds the untracked scaffold output + manifest for your review — commit/push is yours per the acceptance criteria. Watch for: the IGNORE-01 `.gitignore` fix (add the `_meta/*` + negations stanza) and the fact that `.mcp.json` won't show in `git status`.

Update (2026-07-02, evening): the pilot output is now a reviewable PR — **mhi-raptorxai/raptorgpt-agents#541** into `dev` (respecting the repo's dev → uat → main flow), all 7 checks green including the Claude review workflow.

Beyond the raw scaffold output, the PR also: rescues a stray direct-to-uat commit back through dev, and **fixes the IGNORE-01 gap** (the `_meta/*` ignore-with-negations stanza — the secret-risk item from the re-audit). Remaining post-merge gaps drop to 2, both justified (CLAUDE-07 migration debt, ROOT-03 authored AGENTS.md).

One call stated in the PR body: the scaffolded `.mcp.json` stays untracked (the repo's own gitignore ignores that filename — teammates may keep machine-local MCP config there); tracking it is a one-line gitignore change if wanted. The scaffold-warning fix for exactly this class of surprise remains #38.

Closing condition: merge #541, then tick TC-013/TC-010 in the vault test plans = Gate-2 proof.

**Decision update (2026-07-05):** Gate-2 canonical pilot re-pointed from mhi-raptorxai/raptorgpt-agents to hsb3/fleet-dashboard (personal repo; cleaner canonical proof). The raptorgpt run (rgpt#541, defects da#38/da#44 fixed) is kept as a completed prior pilot and its vault sign-off no longer gates Gate 2. Title, body, plan, and the P2 milestone updated to match. TODO (owner): reflect the supersession in the hsb-2026 vault DECISIONS.md.

**Gate-2 BASELINE audit — run 2026-07-12** (foreman-verified: two independent runs, identical result)

- Target: `hsb3/fleet-dashboard` @ `3d81a48` (main, clean tree)
- Command (from fleet-dashboard root): `python3 <dotfiles-agents>/primitives-core/skills/repo-compliance-audit/scripts/audit.py --plugin-root <dotfiles-agents>/primitives-core`
- **Result: 69 pass / 1 gap** — sole gap `DOCS-02: docs/CHARTER.md missing` (authored content; the scaffold never authors charters, same class as wb#30)
- Full verbatim table staged for the plan folder (lands with the next docs PR).

**Finding for the owner:** the baseline is already near-conformant, so the remaining pilot steps (`mise-en-place.yml` → scaffold `--apply` → re-audit) would prove **idempotence on an already-clean repo (~0 creations)** rather than gap-filling. Options: (a) accept idempotence + a separately-authored CHARTER.md as this pilot's completion, or (b) re-point Gate-2 at a repo with real gaps. Also: `_meta/plans/fleet-dashboard-pilot/plan.md` prose still narrates the superseded raptorgpt sequence — needs a refresh either way.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_012GyzR5hNcEfo1ER6GRyqeC

**Owner ruling (2026-07-12, decision brief D1): joint-proof accepted.**

Gate-2 is proven by the two pilots jointly:
- **raptorgpt-agents** (rgpt#541, complete prior pilot) proved **gap-filling**: 36 pass / 22 gap → 56 pass / 3 gap, round-2 committed `d4ab1851`, defects da#38/da#44 fixed.
- **fleet-dashboard** (this pilot) proves **idempotence / no-false-positives on a conformant repo**: baseline 69 pass / 1 gap at `3d81a48` (foreman-verified, two independent runs). The sole gap is `DOCS-02 — docs/CHARTER.md missing`, authored content the scaffold deliberately never creates.

No second re-point. Remaining to close this issue:
1. Run the scaffold `--plan` idempotence check on fleet-dashboard (expect ~0 creations).
2. Author fleet-dashboard's `docs/CHARTER.md` (owner content; a session drafts, owner reviews).
3. Refresh the stale `plan.md` prose (still narrates the raptorgpt sequence).
4. Reflect the supersession in the vault `DECISIONS.md` (the old raptorgpt GO record) — owner TODO.

**Idempotence run complete (2026-07-12)** — the second half of the joint proof (ruling above).

`scaffold.py --plan` on `hsb3/fleet-dashboard` at the baseline commit `3d81a48` (clean tree, plugin root = the freshly merged project-workflow 0.3.1 target):

```
0 create / 3 conflict / 1 manual / 66 ok — plan only, nothing written
```

- **0 create** — the scaffold plans zero new files on the conformant repo: no false-positive gap-filling. This is the idempotence claim, demonstrated.
- **3 conflict** (GH-07 `ci.yml`, ROOT-06 `.gitignore`, DOCS-04 `decisions/README.md`) — existing files that legitimately differ from the templates (fleet-dashboard's own CI lanes, media-pipeline gitignore stanzas, backfilled ADR index). All reported diff-only and left untouched — exactly the additive-only contract.
- **1 manual** (DOCS-02 `docs/CHARTER.md` missing) — the known sole baseline gap; authored content the scaffold never creates, matching the baseline audit.

Remaining to close: draft fleet-dashboard `docs/CHARTER.md` for owner review · refresh this plan's stale raptorgpt-sequence prose · owner reflects the raptorgpt-GO supersession in the vault `DECISIONS.md`.

Closed by owner ruling 2026-07-13: the fleet-dashboard Gate-2 pilot is no longer important — proving happens through real use rather than a staged pilot. Follow-on intent (tracked at the strategy desk): lightweight tracking for bundles that get packaged without passing through the full lifecycle (including the workbench).
